core.title: Stainless Steel Skeleton Key Mortise Lockset With Ball Knob, Acorn KTTJI

text.description_html:
Acorn KTTJI, Stainless Steel Mortise Handleset

This lockset is hand forged in stainless steel. The forging process darkens the hardware in an uneven pattern providing a natural finish similar to antique nickel or pewter. Made for interior doors, the oval shape grants this lockset a modern appearance. An Acorn made lockset, the deadbolt is operated by a skeleton key on both the interior and the exterior.

Unlike a simple tubular latch, this is a mortise lock. They are extremely durable and have a tighter clearance tolerance. You know it's a mortise lock when you hear that heavy, smooth, solid 'click' when the door closes shut.

Features and Specifications of the Mortise Skeleton Key Lockset:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Height: 9-7/8"
  • Width: 2-3/8"
  • Projection: 3"
  • Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" or 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-1/2"

When Selecting the Handing:

The handing actually refers to the mortise lock, rather than the knob.

Double Cylinder: A knob operates the latch from both the interior and the exterior while a key operates the deadbolt from both sides of the door.
